newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish insurer Polisa to start bourse trade Nov 20.
newsitem.headline: Polish insurer Polisa to start bourse trade Nov 20.

text.p: Polish insurance company TUR Polisa SA will start its bourse trade on November 20, the company's president said.
"We have the bourse's management's decision...and we are beginning (bourse trade) on Wednesday, November 20," Stanislaw Gutek told Reuters.
Polisa, which will be listed on the main market of the Warsaw bourse, had a net profit of 2.6 million zlotys and collected 123.1 million zlotys in gross premiums last year.
It expected its net profit to grow to 3.7 million zlotys this year.
